title: Bunk sleeping on the stand and his lip medicines
summary: Russell recalls Bunk asleep on the stand, his stand full of medicines, tincture of myrrh and Dr. Tichenor's antiseptic.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: I can remember that one picture. There's a famous picture that Ouija took, I believe, published in one of his books, where Bunk is sound asleep and slept after the first, maybe, set or the second set anyway. He went to sleep on the stand and sat there until the whole dance was over. And Wild Bill happened to be there and he played and sat within about a yard of him, blowing right straight at him just for fun or for meanness or something. And Bunk never heard him. I'm sure it wasn't just entirely an act, although as soon as it was over, Bunk gets up and goes home plenty quick. And I don't think he staggered home or anything else either. But still, if he didn't want to play, like in Boston, that same thing that came up with Sidney Bechet, he didn't like the band. And he'd sit there all night long rubbing his lip. He had six or seven kinds of medicine all over his music stand. He'd always have his music stand up there. He'd rub some sort of like camphor, different, you know, stuff on there.
He used tincture of myrrh. That's what he gave me a bottle. What was that? And I had a bottle up until recently, the bottle he gave me.
Dr. Tischner's, what do they call it? Antiseptic is one of his favorites. They all use that.
Well, maybe it's the same thing.
Dr. Tischner's a building down here on Canal Street, a big white building right near the ferry boat.
I think it might be the same thing as tincture of myrrh. I'm not sure. I don't know. This is just a clear thing.
It had a lot of alcohol in it. They used to drink during Prohibition.
Oh, yeah. No, that's something else.

I know in Chicago once when I had a tooth pulled, I was down at Mahalia's. And Mahalia and all of her other relatives and different people there, oh, get some Dr. Tischner's ointment and put that in your tooth. Anything that goes wrong at all, they use Dr. Tischner's for. And Bunk always had a bottle of that. But he'd have all these medicines on his music stand, and he'd sit there sometime for two or three sets. I don't think he'd play one piece. Honestly, he'd sit there all night long rubbing that. But any time he wanted to, though, if he'd feel like it and wanted to show us that he could play, we'd go up there once. I went up from Pittsburgh once to Boston to hear him one weekend. Occasionally, about once every set, maybe he'd get his horn out and really blow. He could blow good. And then maybe a broadcast would come on and he'd blow pretty good for that, too, for a set real late at night. But most of the time he'd be sitting there putting on this act or something. And yet his lip wasn't that bad. Go ahead now. We were talking about your impression of hearing and his tone.
